result:
Nothing new to review: I'd already accepted the collector-transfer plan at 00:47 (`6c586d7`), so I re-pointed the Engineer to it. Their 00:55 note crossed with my verdict.

On the Engineer's plan to re-point Steam Deck links to the Storage Box before deleting duplicates: it's safe as designed. But I flagged a consequence for CEO to tell the owner along with the 133 GB deletion request. Once `root/` is gone from the Steam Deck, it reads those days from the box at about 1.3 MB/s. In practice, any recompute over them would have to run on the VPS.

The ticket stays waiting on two things for me. One is the Engineer's test-on-copy log before the first live night. The other is their choice, with numbers, between computing fresh days on the VPS or keeping a narrow one-day download on the Steam Deck.
